_readme: Copy this file to appsettings.json and fill in your values. Never commit appsettings.json — it is gitignored. API keys should be set via dotnet user-secrets or environment variables instead of this file.

Transcription._comment: Azure Cognitive Services Speech endpoint. Get key via: az cognitiveservices account keys list --name <resource> -g <rg> --query key1 -o tsv

Intelligence._comment: Select azure (BYOC) or github. Explicitly choose and test synthesis and live-intelligence models separately. Blank model names are not replaced automatically.

Graph._comment: Legacy Graph settings, not used by the app. Work IQ uses Settings > Sign in to WorkIQ without a user-supplied app registration.

Storage._comment: Local folder where meeting notes (.md files) are saved.

Audio._comment: Enable microphone and/or loopback (system audio) capture. Loopback captures what speakers are playing.

MeetingDetection._comment: Process names eligible for a recording prompt when microphone activity is detected. Never starts recording automatically.
